VaNi GTM — headless page render (STOCK NODES ONLY)

Same contract as the puppeteer variant, but rendering is done
by a browserless container — no community node needed.

POST /vani-render-page
body: { "url": "https://…" }
header: x-vani-secret  (validated by the webhook's Header Auth
credential — NO env vars, NO enterprise features)
Returns { success, url, chars, html }.

SETUP (once):
1. Run browserless on the VPS:
   docker run -d --name browserless --restart unless-stopped \
     -p 3010:3000 -e "TOKEN=<random>" ghcr.io/browserless/chromium
2. Create credential: Credentials → New → Header Auth →
   Name: 'VaNi Render Secret', Header Name: x-vani-secret,
   Header Value: <long random string>
3. Open the Webhook node, select that credential.
4. Open the 'Render Page (browserless)' node and put your
   browserless URL+token directly in the URL field
   (replace the $env expression):
   http://<host>:3010/content?token=<TOKEN>
5. Import/activate. (Deactivate the puppeteer variant first —
   same webhook path.)

**2026-10-01:** renders via browserless `/function`: returns the HTML as before PLUS `brand` — the colours, font and logo the browser actually painted (brand-collector.js). Same webhook path and response shape; `brand` is an added field.
